label: bol.com
terms_note: Requires a bol.com retailer (partner) account (NL/BE); credentials self-issued in the Partner Platform, no app review; since Feb 2025 every offer must reference an Economic Operator ID (EU GPSR); rate limits enforced per endpoint and published at api.bol.com/retailer/public/ratelimits with headers in responses; demo environment for testing.

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (client id + secret from the Partner Platform → login.bol.com/token; ~5-minute tokens)
sdks: OpenAPI spec + Postman collection + Redoc published by bol.com (api.bol.com/retailer/public/…)

rate_limits: per path, published as JSON: offers PUT 50/s, offer price/stock PUT 50/s, GET offer 25/s, orders list 25/min, order GET 25/s, shipments POST 25/s, returns 20/min, offer export 9/h, inventory 20/min

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the auditor.
auth: 1. Tenant logs in to the bol.com Partner Platform and creates API credentials (client id + client secret).
2. Exchange them at login.bol.com/token (client_credentials) → bearer token valid ~299 s; cache and refresh.
3. Call api.bol.com/retailer with `Authorization: Bearer` + the v10 Accept header.

endpoints.purpose: create offer (EAN, condition, price, stock, fulfilment FBR/FBB)
performance indicators, search terms, competitor prices, rankings

reference.limits: Enforced per endpoint; current values at https://api.bol.com/retailer/public/ratelimits; responses carry X-RateLimit headers; 429 on breach. - Retailer account required (bol.com partner agreement, NL/BE). - Every offer needs an Economic Operator ID since Feb 2025 (EU product-safety regulation). - Credentials are self-serve; no third-party app review.
mcp_sdk: SDK: OpenAPI spec + Postman collection + Redoc published by bol.com (api.bol.com/retailer/public/…)

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of Retailer API credentials created in the bol Seller Dashboard (Settings > API settings); exchanged at POST https://login.bol.com/token (grant_type=client_credentials, HTTP Basic) for a short-lived (~5 minute) JWT.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The matching client secret. The token is cached until expiry (bol blocks clients that request a token for every call).

adapter.terms: bol Retailer API v10 (NL/BE). Write calls are asynchronous: they answer 202 with a process status (processStatusId, status PENDING|SUCCESS|FAILURE|TIMEOUT) to poll at GET /shared/process-status/{id}. All calls use the vendor media type application/vnd.retailer.v10+json.

me.note: No account endpoint without the retailer id; the probe obtains a token and reads page 1 of open orders ({orders[]}) to verify the credentials.

update_listing.note: PUT /retailer/offers/{offer-id}/price {pricing: {bundlePrices: [{quantity: 1, unitPrice}]}} replaces the LIVE price of the offer with a single unit price (EUR, any volume/bundle prices are removed). `price` is required; stock is set_inventory; the product title is catalogue data. Returns a process status (status PENDING at first).

set_inventory.note: PUT /retailer/offers/{offer-id}/stock {amount, managedByRetailer: false} sets the stock of one offer (listing_id = bol offer id, required; offers are not addressed by SKU here). managedByRetailer false means bol deducts sold items from the amount. Asynchronous process status.

end_listing.note: DELETE /retailer/offers/{offer-id} deletes the offer (not reversible; a new offer must be created). To pause it instead, set stock 0. Asynchronous process status.

list_orders.note: GET /retailer/orders?page(50 per page)&status(OPEN|SHIPPED|ALL, default OPEN)&latest-change-date(YYYY-MM-DD, up to 3 months back) for orders fulfilled by the retailer (FBR). The list carries no amounts; `status` is the first order item's fulfilmentStatus (OPEN|HANDLED). raw.orderItems[].orderItemId is what mark_shipped needs.

mark_shipped.note: POST /retailer/shipments {orderItems: [{orderItemId}], transport: {transporterCode, trackAndTrace}} ships ONE ORDER ITEM with your own transporter: `order_id` must be the orderItemId (raw.orderItems[].orderItemId of list_orders), called once per item. `carrier` is a bol transporterCode from the transporters list in the Retailer API docs (e.g. TNT for PostNL, DHL, DPD-NL). Asynchronous process status.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /retailer/offers needs the product EAN, condition and fulfilment method/delivery code plus pricing and stock; the vocabulary has no EAN or condition (sku is not bol's product key).

evidence: host api.bol.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://api.bol.com/retailer/public/apispec/Retailer%20API%20-%20v10: 6/6 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
